configurations._comment: Windows (Yogesh). JSON has no raw backslashes in strings — every one in a path must be doubled, or the whole file fails to parse and NONE of these servers can be started.
configurations.name: frontend

configurations._comment: Windows (Yogesh). The REAL backend, PINNED to the throwaway database -- the twin of mac-backend, which Windows never had. DB_NAME is set on the command line and NOT read from backend/.env, because that file is the founder's and points at live data whenever it has been restored. Messaging keys are blanked for the same reason: backend/.env carries a live APM_SMS_API_KEY and no browser check may text a real person. DEV_OTP_IN_RESPONSE returns the code instead of sending it.
configurations.name: win-backend-scratch
runtimeArgs: set DB_NAME=dos_engine_0921c&& set DEV_OTP_IN_RESPONSE=1&& set APM_SMS_API_KEY=&& set APM_OTP_ENDPOINT=&& set TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID=&& set TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=&& set TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER=&& set WHATSAPP_TOKEN=&& set WHATSAPP_PHONE_ID=&& set WHATSAPP_API_KEY=&& set WA_TENANT_ID=&& set SMTP_HOST=&& set RATE_LIMITS=off&& C:\\Users\\kyogesh\\Desktop\\Skills\\DecisioOS\\DecisionOS\\backend\\.venv\\Scripts\\python.exe -m uvicorn server:app --app-dir C:\\Users\\kyogesh\\Desktop\\Skills\\DecisioOS\\DecisionOS\\backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --log-level warning

configurations._comment: macOS. The fixture API (scripts/fixture-server.mjs) — no database, no backend. Start it before mac-frontend to see the app with data in it.
configurations.name: mac-fixture-api

configurations._comment: macOS. The REAL backend, PINNED to the throwaway database. DB_NAME is set on the command line and NOT read from backend/.env, because that file is the founder's and points at the live database whenever it has been restored — starting a test backend must never depend on which way that file happens to be pointing. Messaging keys are blanked for the same reason: backend/.env carries a live APM_SMS_API_KEY, and no test may text a real person.
configurations.name: mac-backend
runtimeArgs: cd backend && DB_NAME=decisionos-e2e-round1 APM_SMS_API_KEY= APM_OTP_ENDPOINT= TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID= TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN= TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER= WHATSAPP_API_KEY= WA_TENANT_ID= DEV_OTP_IN_RESPONSE=1 .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000

configurations._comment: macOS. The PRODUCTION web server (frontend/server.js) against the built frontend/build — the same process Railway runs. Use it to check things that only exist in production: the /.well-known/assetlinks.json route, the SPA fallback, and the runtime PostHog key substitution. Needs `npm run build` first.
configurations.name: mac-web-prod
runtimeArgs: cd frontend && PORT=3200 POSTHOG_KEY=phc_runtime_probe ANDROID_APP_FINGERPRINT=AA:BB:CC node server.js
